Further information is available at our corporate website www.enterprise-ireland.com Page | 10 3 Scope of the Framework Agreement 3.1 Type of Framework Agreement Enterprise Ireland proposes to engage in a competitive process for the establishment of a single-party framework agreement. A framework agreement constitutes a means of establishing overall terms and conditions in accordance with which, during the s pecified duration, individual contracts may or may not be awarded. It is emphasised that a framework agreement constitutes no guarantee to purchase a specific quantity of supplies or services from a particular economic operator. Indeed, Enterprise Ireland reserves the right to operate outside of the framework agreement at its discretion, particularly should it become apparent that doing so would offer greater value for money. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the framework agreement approach has been adopted in order to leverage efficiencies and maximise cost savings over the duration of the framework. 3.2 Numbers Admitted to the Framework Agreement The Framework Agreement will be established as a single party Framework Agreement with the Successful Tenderer selected following the submission of Final Tenders and the application of the Award Criteria. Confirmăm că din măsurătoare se exclud componentele aflate în afara controlului ofertantului — procesatorul de plăți extern și rețeaua utilizatorului final. Baza de raportare pentru „creșterea de până la 150%‖ este pragul minim absolut prevăzut la cap. 8.1 (500 cereri concurente), rezultând un plafon de dimensionare recomandat de până la 750 de cereri concurente în scenarii de vârf. 73. Întrebarea nr. 24 Referință: Caietul de sarcini, cap. 8.1 pct. 8, coroborat cu cap. 4.8.1 și cap. 4.8.7 Text vizat: „Timp de funcţionare (uptime): minim 99,5% lunar (exprimat ca SLO)” şi „Timpul maxim admis de indisponibilitate programată: 4 ore/lună”. Solicitare: O disponibilitate de 99,5% lunar corespunde unui buget total de indisponibilitate de aproximativ 3 ore și 36 de minute într-o lună de 30 de zile, deci sub cele 4 ore pe lună admise pentru mentenanța programată. Vă rugăm să confirmați că, la fel ca la cap. 4.8.1 și 4.8.7, ferestrele de mentenanță programată se exc

uzual, asincronă și nu asigură prin ea însăși comutare automată fără pierdere de date între zone. Vă rugăm să precizați valorile-țintă de RPO și RTO pentru baza de date și să confirmați că se acceptă soluții echivalente care asigură aceste valori prin alte mecanisme — replicare sincronă, cluster cu comutare automată sau serviciu de bază de date gestionat cu redundanță multizonă — inclusiv atunci când terminologia „master-slave‖ nu este aplicabilă. Răspuns: Caietul de sarcini nu indică valori-țintă explicite de RPO (Recovery Point Objective) și RTO (Recovery Time Objective) pentru baza de date. Cu titlu de prag minim acceptabil, recomandat pentru fundamentarea ofertei: RPO ≤ 15 minute și RTO ≤ 4 ore, aliniat plafonului maxim de indisponibilitate lunară de la cap. 8.1 pct. 8, ofertantul putând propune și justifica, prin soluția tehnică ofertată, valori egale sau mai bune. Confirmăm că se acceptă soluții echivalente care asigură aceste valori prin alte mecanisme decât replicarea master-slave clasică — replicare sincronă, cluster cu comutare automată (failover automat) sau serviciu de bază de date gestionat, cu redundanță multizonă — inclusiv în situațiile în care terminologia „master-slave‖ nu este aplicabilă arhitecturii propuse, conform principiului „sau echivalent‖. 7

NOAA prohibits sexual assault and sexual harassment by or of any employee, supervisor, manager, contractor, vendor, affiliate, or other individual with whom NOAA employees come into contact by the virtue of their work for NOAA. (a) Definitions. Contractor Employees - The term “contractor employees,” as used in this solicitation and contract language, refers to employees of the prime contractor or its subcontractors, affiliates, consultants, or team members. Sexual Assault - The term sexual assault, as used in this solicitation and contract language, means any conduct proscribed by state or federal sexual abuse laws, including, but not limited to, those defined in chapter 109A of title 18 of the U.S. Code (sexual abuse), and assaults committed both by offenders who are strangers to the victim and by offenders who are known or related by blood or marriage to the victim. Sexual Harassment - As defined by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, sexual harassment is a form of sex discrimination that violates Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. 1. Introduction

The African Union Development Agency – New Partnership for Africa Development (AUDA-NEPAD) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the “Resilient Irrigation for a Sustainable Economy Project”, and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. “Consultancy Services to Develop and Deploy the Africa RISE Gateway”

 

  1. Description of Services

The consulting services (“the Services”) include: Task 1: Africa RISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and proc

ISE User Requirements Assessment: Map and profile all user groups and partners including relevant African Union agencies and departments (AUDANEPAD, AU-SAFGRAD, SEBE), government ministries, transboundary water management agencies, regulators, MPA focal points, implementing partners, research institutes and universities and technical experts, farmers, aggregators, private sector, equipment suppliers and financial institutions and farmer unions and cooperative societies etc; Task 2: Design, Develop and Commission the Africa RISE Gateway: Define system architecture, data structures, modules, dashboard requirements and process workflows, including a unified data interoperability Layer that meets vPIC standards and aligns with the Africa RISE Regional Geospatial Analytics Platform and national irrigation monitoring systems.  The architecture shall specify: (a) the endpoints and payload schemas through which national data collection tools, the Regional Geospatial Platform,  and other authorized external data sources submit and validate benchmarking data; (b) the data lineage and version control mechanisms ensuring that published benchmarks are traceable to their submission source; and (c) the traffic-light alert logic that translates performanc

sociated training materials for all user groups, comprising: (i) a Technical Track for AUDA-NEPAD IT personnel, national technical focal points and system administrators, covering system administration, data management, integration and cybersecurity; (ii) an Operational Track for programme managers, extension officers and policy stakeholders, focusing on effective use of the platform and its functional modules; and (iii) an End-User Track providing simplified guidance and orientation materials. Task 4: Sustainable Operation and Maintenance (O&M) Model for the Gateway: Assess the technical and operational requirements for sustained operation of the Gateway, including hosting, security, data management, updates, user support and maintenance schedules and prepare indicative annual cost projections for the post-project period. Task 5: Envisaged functionality of the Africa RISE Gateway: The Africa RISE Gateway, as a go-to information and knowledge solution, is envisaged to serve.

SCOPE OF WORK The vendor will develop and implement a creative, physical messaging campaign to publicize safe, official repatriation mechanisms in target communities across Honduras. Activities will include the design, procurement, and deployment of everyday, high-turnover physical media—such as reusable bags, food packaging, or other take-home items—to deliver messaging about repatriation mechanisms to the family members of Honduran nationals currently residing illegally in the United States. To realize this initiative, the selected organization will be responsible for building strategic relationships with private sector micro-logistics networks, small business owners, commercial brands, or community merchant associations across five Honduran cities to successfully disseminate and deploy the branded materials directly into target zones. ip_data_security.text: the cost of services needed to operate and maintain NLS’s My Talking Books (an Amazon Alexa skill) in production. My Talking Books is an Amazon Alexa skill that enables NLS patrons to search the NLS collection, browse the NLS collection, retrieve/manage the patron’s Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) Wishlist, stream NLS talking books, and manage the patron’s Bookshelf using a voice-only interface available on Alexa-enabled commercial smart-speaker platforms. The contractor shall be responsible for providing RealSAM Dialog licenses and services required to operate the system in production, while meeting all IT information-system security requirements as required by the Library of Congress. C.2 BACKGROUND NLS administers a free program that loans audio and braille books and magazines, music scores in braille and large print, and specially designed audio-playback and refreshable-braille-display equipment to residents of the United States who are unable to read or use standard print materials due to visual or physical impairment. NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. S. Virgin Islands. Thi

hall provide the Library with license and technical support. This support shall be provided on an annual basis at a firm-fixed price. This support shall be provided in blocks of 500. This support service must ensure that users with legacy RealSAM Dialog licenses can use the My Talking Books skill in production. The contractor shall provide the Library with a price schedule (Attachment J3 - Pricing Chart.xlsx) for the following scenarios: A. RealSAM Dialog License Support – An annual fee for blocks of 500 perpetual user licenses for the RealSAM dialog engine. This scenario reflects the current state of affairs where the contractor is hosting all required non-GFE services (Auth Proxy, Streaming Servers, Dialog Engine, etc.). B. RealSAM Dialog License Support with Auth Proxy hosted by the Library – same as scenario A, but the Library would host the Auth Proxy service instead of the contractor. C. RealSAM Legacy Dialog License Support with Auth Proxy and Streaming Servers hosted by the Library – same as scenario A, but the Library would host both the Auth Proxy service and Streaming Servers instead of the contractor. II. Minimum Technical Requirements: The following are the minimum requirements/tasks: A. General requirements a. Complete a comprehensive on-site survey for analysis of all work i. Minimum capacities equivalent to current lab capacities except where noted below b. Comply with all current safety, design, and construction regulations i. Especially concerning pressurized gases and combustible/oxidizing gases c. Coordinate with WPAFB CE as required for appropriate permitting (building intrusions, hot-work, roof installations, etc.) d. Swagelok certified safety/distribution/venting panels PN: CONCEPT DRAWING 6.3-F34 REV 2.0 10/15/24, Concept CS-AFIT-SERVICE-PANEL- FUELS/OXIDIZERS e. Certified review of all components and designs by a unified project manager f. Installation by Sw
